cards.card_text: The list keeps going: the arrow that flies by day, the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, the calamity that destroys at noon.
cards.verse_text: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day, nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
cards.snippet: …of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day, nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.

cards.card_text: Earthquakes and famines and pestilences Floods and droughts and wildfires Locusts and hail and darkness
cards.verse_text: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
cards.snippet: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.

cards.card_text: He calls Paul a pestilence, stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world.
cards.verse_text: We have found this man to be a pestilence, stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world.
cards.snippet: We have found this man to be a pestilence, stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world.
